environment.description: A single environment, or ALL (Fleet only): navigation across separately authorized environments. An ALL body lists the authorized rows of every environment that answered, each row with its own environment and economic partitions, plus environment_coverage. It never carries a total over environments or partitions.

profile_id.description: Selected concrete source profile. Omitted for the backward-compatible three-environment ALL defaults view; not an all-installed-profile union.

environment_coverage.description: ALL only: exactly one entry per environment, in the order paper, sandbox, live. INCLUDED carries that environment's own snapshot, clocks, quality and counts (a counted zero is INCLUDED with 0). UNAVAILABLE carries a closed reason and nothing else: a missing environment is typed, never absent and never zero. page.authorized_filtered_count and page.returned_count are the sums of the INCLUDED entries (rows, never money); quality is never COMPLETE while an environment is UNAVAILABLE (MANAGER_ALL_*).

page.description: returned_count is items.length, at most limit and at most authorized_filtered_count; a non-empty page with neither cursor is the whole filtered result (returned_count equals authorized_filtered_count). JSON Schema cannot compare a count with an array length: the producer refuses to emit a body that breaks this (MANAGER_PAGE_*), and the reader refuses it too. The schema states the empty case exactly.

group_page.description: Pagination over all authorized filtered groups, independent of page/items. A null next_cursor means complete; exactly 200 groups need not be truncated. Group aggregates retain their full group population.

anyOf.description: Canonical zero: a zero is never signed. "0" and "0.00" are valid, "-0" and "-0.00" are not; a source value of "-0.00" is published as "0.00" (same scale, no sign). The producer refuses to emit the signed form (MANAGER_DECIMAL_NEGATIVE_ZERO).

metrics.description: A money metric that names a currency is the figure of exactly one partition listed in economic_partitions (the same metric), never a total across partitions. When a query pins one economic_partition the row still lists its other partitions and the headline is the pinned partition's figure (MANAGER_HEADLINE_NOT_A_PARTITION_FIGURE).

economic_partitions.description: A partition appears once per list (identity: economic_domain, currency, basis, native_profile_ref; domain_proof_ref is evidence, not identity). A metric that names a currency names its partition's currency. uniqueItems here catches an exact repeat; a repeat of the identity with different metrics is refused by the producer (MANAGER_PARTITION_DUPLICATE) and by the reader, because JSON Schema cannot compare a property of two items. Open PERCENT keys max_drawdown_pct and win_rate_pct (BE-B1, MD-9): no currency; unit PERCENT when available; win_rate_pct is within 0..100 (MANAGER_PERCENT_METRIC_HAS_CURRENCY, MANAGER_PERCENT_METRIC_UNIT_INVALID, MANAGER_WIN_RATE_OUT_OF_RANGE). The key is omitted when no source fact states it: omission is Not published, never 0.

environment.description: ALL only: the environment this row belongs to. row_key is [environment, alpha_id, alpha_version_id, portfolio_id] and every economic partition of the row is of that environment's economic domain (live: ACTUAL).

items.description: A row appears once: row_key is unique within a body (MANAGER_ROW_KEY_DUPLICATE). uniqueItems catches an exact repeat; a repeated row_key with different content is refused by the producer.

groups.description: A group appears once (identity: key) and holds no more unique rows than page.authorized_filtered_count (MANAGER_GROUP_DUPLICATE, MANAGER_GROUP_COUNT_OVER_FILTERED). Its key names a field of query_options.group_fields once (MANAGER_GROUP_FIELD_NOT_OFFERED).
